Remarks on markown pricing optimization. A code which represents a particular optimization result or markdown pricing reason. Valid codes are:
'OPTIMIZER_STR_ACHIEVED': optimal discount solution satisfies target STR requirement and achieves the highest gate sales it could.
'LOW_PRICE': Group price meets the low price criteria. Applied the low price rule directly without optimization.
'OPTIMIZER_STR_NOT_ACHIEVED_STORE_INVENTORY': optimal discount solution DOES NOT satisfy target STR requirement due to the remaining store inventory.
'OPTIMIZER_STR_NOT_ACHIEVED_UPSTREAM_INVENTORY': optimal discount solution DOES NOT satisfy target STR requirement due to the remaining upstream inventory.
'INFEASIBLE_DEFAULT_MARKDOWN': infeasible optimization. No feasible markdown price lies within min and max bounds. Applied default markdown.
'BUDGET_INFEASIBLE_MIN_MARKDOWN': infeasible optimization. The plan does not stay witihn the budget required. Applied min markdown.
'MISSING_ELASTICITY_MIN_MARKDOWN': missing elasticity. Applied min markdown.
'ZERO_OR_MISSING_AVG_DAILY_SALE_MIN_MARKDOWN': zero or missing average daily sales data. Applied min markdown.
'ZERO_OR_MISSING_PROJECTED_INVENTORY_MIN_MARKDOWN': zero or missing projected start inventory at gate
'MARKDOWN_NOT_NEEDED': markdown is not mandatory. Target STR achieved without any markdown.
